name: session-end-unpin
description: Unpins the session from the desktop app's sidebar once you ask to end it and Claude finds nothing left: the end-of-session steps done, no question, decision or follow-up waiting

phrases.title: Phrases that ask to end the session
phrases.description: Comma-separated. A message holding every word of one of them, in any order and ignoring case, asks to end the session. An English word counts only on its own (end, not send).
phrases.default: 세션 종료, session 종료, 세션 end, end session
